    Given the image and the chart of rwb-case version 1
    When both are read
    Then no rule table and no rule package is in the image or the chart
    Then the package version is fetched and checksum-verified by the kit at start (DP-04; D-RCV-36 T5)

  Scenario: AC7 The record and the state change commit in one transaction (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a transfer whose decision-record write fails in SIT

    Given the rendered api deployment
    When a transfer POST is repeated with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the second answer is the stored response of the first and no second transfer is made
    Then the store is provided by the platform library and the chart declares no store (Architecture v5 slide 11; TSD P3 API-P3-006)
